posts.title: I hate QuickBooks Online, so I cloned it
posts.description: TL;DR: I built wanderbooks . It's a free, open source, formally verified double-entry accounting engine. The only way to change your books is by talking to an AI (Claude Code or Codex) over MCP. The way you look at your books is a simple, fast, read-only viewer. No subscription. No account. posts.title: Does repeater time matter in MeshCore?
posts.description: TL;DR: No, not for actual mesh packet repeating. A repeater with the wrong time will flood and forward packets identically to one with the correct time. The only effects are cosmetic/informational. Edit: This post was challenged with seven counterarguments. I verified each one against the source.
